Project Overview
In today’s fast-paced business landscape, quick access to critical information is essential for success, especially for users investing in Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platforms. Traditionally, navigating through extensive documents and PDFs to find specific information has been time-consuming. To address this challenge, we’ve integrated a chatbot directly into their ERP platform.
The chatbot integration offers paid users instant access to relevant information, saving time and boosting productivity. Harnessing artificial intelligence, users can ask questions, and the chatbot retrieves precise answers from a tailored knowledge base. This knowledge base primarily contains documents on how to use the ERP software, its features, and more.It seamlessly integrates into the ERP platform, providing a user-friendly interface for easy interaction on both desktop and mobile devices.
Multilingual support in English and Spanish ensures inclusivity for all users, while a comprehensive knowledge base guarantees accurate responses. By streamlining access to information, the chatbot enhances productivity and enables users to focus on high-priority tasks. Overall, the integration revolutionizes how users access information within the ERP platform, improving satisfaction and efficiency across the organization.

Features
Multilingual Document Upload: Administrators can upload documents in various languages to the platform.
Language Detection: The system automatically detects the language of the uploaded document.
Multilingual Response Generation: Based on the detected language, the bot generates responses in multiple languages, such as Spanish and German.
Conversational History Tracking: The admin panel includes a feature for tracking and monitoring conversational history.
Analysis and Insights: Through the admin panel, administrators can analyze conversational data for insights and improvements.
Unanswered Questions Highlighted: Unanswered questions in the chatbot will be highlighted in red history, alerting the administrator to upload relevant information to the knowledge base.
